name: confiscate_takes_a_noncreature_permanent_until_it_leaves
notes: M6 mapper. Printed: 'Enchant permanent. You control enchanted permanent.' Seat 0 casts Confiscate on seat 1's artifact (a noncreature permanent) and on resolution controls it (confiscate_takes_a_noncreature_permanent pins that). The control is the Aura's own static effect, so when the Aura is destroyed (moved to the graveyard by another effect) the artifact goes back to seat 1, its owner (CR 611.2, 704.5q).
